title: Nike paid $35 for Swoosh logo, then gifted designer stock and gold ring

Twelve years later, Davidson received a gold ring shaped like the Swoosh and 500 shares of Nike stock. Her design became one of the world’s most recognisable brand symbols, marking a lasting contribution to Nike’s identity.

A permanent 10-foot statue of Ravan has been repainted annually for about a century. Villagers gather to enact scenes from the Ramayana, culminating in the symbolic killing of Ravan. This practice reflects local respect for Ravan as a scholar rather than merely a villain.

title: ‘Zelenskyy should get someone else’: Trump open to Putin-Xi talks on Ukraine war
content: Donald Trump says he is open to holding trilateral talks with putin and Xi . he said the proposed meeting would primarily focus on nuclear weapons and denuclearisation . the remarks came after the Kremlin said a possible trilateral meeting had been discussed .

title: Russia’s digital Achilles’ heel? How Ukraine data centre strikes disrupt daily life
content: drone strikes have disrupted banking, taxi services, food deliveries and digital access to homes . this comes as Kyiv expands its campaign against Moscow’s technology infrastructure . the attacks targeted data centres operated by Yandex, Russia’s largest technology company, followed by a facility owned by Sberbank .

title: ‘India ultimate target of Western regime-change forces’: RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat
